prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token

if type(token) is not str or not token:

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token
token=load_guard_daemon_auth_token(Path('/product/guard'))
if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import http.client,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.daemon.manager import load_guard_daemon_auth_token

if type(token) is not str or not token:
    raise SystemExit(69)
connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',18765,timeout=float(sys.argv[2])-1)
try:
    connection.request('POST','/v1/hooks/omp/readiness',
        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,

 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

try:

        body=json.dumps({'workspace':sys.argv[1]}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Guard-Token':token})
    response=connection.getresponse()
    body=response.read(4097)
    if len(body)>4096:raise SystemExit(69)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
    raise SystemExit(0 if response.status==200 else 69)
finally:
    connection.close()

review.document:
Implementation-author local equivalence review: fresh controls182-187, controller052, actual installed repaired3.46.0 product.
Python source258918894e73376769a745696e9843fd1528f4b8; Native6487dc466ad6f08ac697bc987e0984f4c7324040. Full runtime prefix and all41 controller execution sources are pinned.
Normal OMP workspace setup now precedes semantic admission within the original startup deadline. Only the exact canonical daemon-startup workspace is admitted outside home; unrelated parents, siblings, children and symlinks remain rejected. No hook payload can add an authority root.
The OMP proxy, lazy request executor, original-binding completion proof and sibling-root compatibility repairs change transport/correctness, not policy floors or approvals. No task permissions, ownership, capabilities, LSM/syscalls, resource ceilings or network destinations were widened.
The controller now supports native deletion of its validated request: original descriptor/inode retirement is required. Missing names with renamed or replaced originals still fail; no replacement link is followed. Fresh38-file bootstrap includes that reviewed code and unchanged initializer.31 actual Linux handoff/plane contracts pass.
182 proves actual SDK/MCP/Native contained Node command, exact output and one Post plus replay refusal;183 proves actual Node/npm closure through contained Python;184 proves hard timeout and Native descendant cleanup before the cell backstop;185 retains cancellation samples;186 refuses altered requests;187 refuses forbidden paths/peers/network. All signed controls use zero inference.
Transport controls129-131 had nominal zero exits but failed signed custody due double-retirement bookkeeping. They are not included.126-127 native resident startup timeouts remain retained reliability findings; no diagnostic repetition was pooled into this fresh set.
Linux Native children now receive fixed MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2, without inheriting allocator or loader controls. The earlier resident reached RLIMIT_AS=1GiB despite lowRSS; all original limits remain unchanged. The first allocator change lost its setting in the final Native-client filter:172 still failed and169-171 had no reliable headroom. The completed final-filter repair is separately checked by normal cold-start controls179-181, with one large non-main arena reservation and virtual address use below the unchanged1GiB ceiling. Those setup controls do not supply conformance or statistical efficacy credit.
Local integrity and scoped implementation-author conformance only. No independent review, statistical efficacy, task utility, released-package compatibility or qualification is implied. Full fresh workflow matrix, portable bootstrap validation and exact-byte external user review remain required.

requirements.cancellation: 185: actual cancellation and sampled descendant cleanup; the cell remains until terminal accounting and owned resources are closed.
requirements.cleanup: 182–187: SDK removed, cgroups absent, profiles unloaded, image leases released and upstream children/sessions/workers drained. Zero model requests; no utility or independent-review credit.
requirements.identity: 182–187: outside kernel peer authentication binds the exact SDK UID18301 PID before import; Native and MCP identities remain separate. No product import into Root.
requirements.input-output-replay: 182: actual prompt/Pre/contained sink/Post/output delivery and one-time/replay refusals.186: nine request-binding negatives. Context projection changes only provider presentation, never execution input or captured output. Explicit package version3.46.0 is bound to runtime v5; fresh original-binding output and one-use completion proof apply. Renamed or substituted request directories fail cleanup; native retirement is accepted only when the original Linux inode is unlinked.
requirements.network: 187: actual Native-contained IPv4 and IPv6 connections fail with ENETUNREACH. SDK/product private network topology and forbidden peer access are measured outside.
requirements.proc-paths: 182–187: preserved proc masks and private namespace layout; the equivalent backend uses its declared normal execution environment rather than removing masks from the old failing image.
requirements.readonly-inputs: 182–187: pinned SDK/public helpers and installed Guard prefix are mounted readonly and checked before/after; source/manifest/profile pins remain exact.
requirements.resources: 182–187: outside cgroup/task/memory/CPU observations and the single-core profile are checked. Startup under controller umask0077 retains private state and explicit public scaffold traversal.
requirements.separation: 182–187: separate SDK, product and controller namespaces; same-UID sibling impersonation refused; controller/provider/peer canaries remain outside delegated mounts.
requirements.syscalls-devices: 182–187: versioned enforcing AppArmor/seccomp, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, fixed devices and readonly system inputs remain required; no floor is relaxed.
requirements.task-custody: 182–187: literal owned task/provider paths and inode/UID/GID/mode observations surround idmapping. Native writes map back to physical UID18301; private task modes are preserved.
requirements.timeout: 184: hard timeout returns terminal evidence and reaps the detached descendant before cell teardown; required Post and cleanup remain checked.
